ftbquest.stage_3.quests7.description0: Petroleum is not a singular thing, it is composed by inumerous hydrocarbons and impurities. The sole purpose of a refinery is to separate, purify and combine these different hydrocarbons to create useful products.
ftbquest.stage_3.quests7.tasks1.title: Automated
ftbquest.stage_3.quests7.title: Black Gold
ftbquest.stage_3.quests8.description0: The foremost of steps in petroleum processing is mixing with water to create a brine.
ftbquest.stage_3.quests8.description1: This brine will remove the salt and other impurities contained within the extracted fluid.
ftbquest.stage_3.quests8.tasks1.title: Automated
ftbquest.stage_3.quests8.title: Decantation
ftbquest.stage_3.quests9.description0: Use an electrolyzer to remove the last of impurities, resulting in a clean oil ready for distillation.
ftbquest.stage_3.quests9.description1: The removed salt shall be used for creating caustic soda later.
ftbquest.stage_3.quests9.tasks1.title: Automated
ftbquest.stage_3.quests9.title: Desalting
ftbquest.stage_3.quests11.description0: Your usual 2x2 pool of water will suffice.
ftbquest.stage_3.quests11.tasks1.title: Automated
ftbquest.stage_3.quests11.title: Water Source
ftbquest.stage_3.quests12.description0: How gases do not escape the basin remains a mystery, but it is better to not think too much about it.
ftbquest.stage_3.quests12.tasks1.title: Automated
ftbquest.stage_3.quests12.title: Basin Boiler
ftbquest.stage_3.quests13.description0: The pre-flash drum uses flash distillation to remove the lightest fractions of petroleum before the main atmospheric distillation.
ftbquest.stage_3.quests13.description1: Flash distillation separates fluids by pressure rather than heat, therefore, insert steam into the controller along with desalted petroleum.
ftbquest.stage_3.quests13.description2: Bear in mind that pipes will not connect to the steel tanks in distillation mode, use this for your advantage.
ftbquest.stage_3.quests13.tasks0.title: Done
ftbquest.stage_3.quests13.title: Pre-Flash Drum
ftbquest.stage_3.quests14.description0: Volatile gas is the top fraction of the flash distillation, it comprises various volatile gases that can be further separated.
ftbquest.stage_3.quests14.tasks1.title: Automated
ftbquest.stage_3.quests14.title: Volatile Gas
ftbquest.stage_3.quests15.description0: Light naphta is the middle fraction of flash distillation, it can be processed into plastic via steam cracking.
ftbquest.stage_3.quests15.tasks1.title: Automated
ftbquest.stage_3.quests15.title: Light Naphta
ftbquest.stage_3.quests16.description0: Oil is the bottom fraction of flash distillation, without the volatile compounds after flash distillation it can proceed into the atmospheric distillation column.
ftbquest.stage_3.quests16.tasks1.title: Automated
ftbquest.stage_3.quests17.description0: The atmospheric distillation column is the second and most complex of the columns, in here, distillation happens close to atmospheric pressure, hence the name.
ftbquest.stage_3.quests17.tasks0.title: Done
ftbquest.stage_3.quests17.title: Atmospheric Distillation
ftbquest.stage_3.quests18.description0: Heavy naphta is the top fraction out of the atmospheric distillation. It's direct line goes into gasoline mixing.
ftbquest.stage_3.quests18.tasks1.title: Automated
ftbquest.stage_3.quests19.description0: Kerosene is the fifth fraction out of the atmospheric distillation. It is the root of the line that will eventually become rocket fuel.
ftbquest.stage_3.quests19.tasks1.title: Automated
ftbquest.stage_3.quests20.description0: The fourth fraction out of the atmospheric distillation, the lighter counterpart of diesel only requires desulfurization before it becomes a final product.
ftbquest.stage_3.quests20.tasks1.title: Automated
ftbquest.stage_3.quests21.description0: The third fraction out of the atmospheric distillation and heavier counterpart of diesel, requires more processing to become refined diesel, however it is more abundant.
ftbquest.stage_3.quests21.tasks1.title: Automated
ftbquest.stage_3.quests22.description0: Light Gas Oil is the second fraction out of atmospheric distillation, it can be processed into fuel oil, naphta or a compound for the gasoline mixture.
ftbquest.stage_3.quests22.tasks1.title: Automated
ftbquest.stage_3.quests23.description0: Oil residue is the bottom fraction out of the atmospheric distillation. Residue does not mean it's waste! It still contains useful heavy hydrocarbons.
ftbquest.stage_3.quests23.tasks1.title: Automated
ftbquest.stage_3.quests24.description0: Less sulfur also means better fuel performance.
ftbquest.stage_3.quests24.tasks1.title: Automated
ftbquest.stage_3.quests24.title: Desulfurizer #4
ftbquest.stage_3.quests25.description0: Removing sulfur is crucial as it could poison catalysts and damage machinery further in the refinery.
ftbquest.stage_3.quests25.tasks1.title: Automated
ftbquest.stage_3.quests25.title: Desulfurizer #3
ftbquest.stage_3.quests26.description0: &6Hydrodesulfurization&r uses hydrogen to remove sulfur from the oil derivates.
ftbquest.stage_3.quests26.tasks1.title: Automated
ftbquest.stage_3.quests26.title: Desulfurizer #1
ftbquest.stage_3.quests27.description0: Hydrogen steals sulfur atoms from within the molecules and produces hydrogen sulfide, which can be filtered out.
ftbquest.stage_3.quests27.tasks1.title: Automated
ftbquest.stage_3.quests27.title: Desulfurizer #2
ftbquest.stage_3.quests28.description0: The resulting creation of hydrogen sulfide can also be processed.
ftbquest.stage_3.quests28.tasks1.title: Automated
ftbquest.stage_3.quests28.title: Sulfurized
ftbquest.stage_3.quests29.description0: Use electrolysis of water to bootstrap the hydrodesulfurization machinery and furthermore realize cracking of heavy compounds.
ftbquest.stage_3.quests29.tasks1.title: Automated
ftbquest.stage_3.quests29.title: Hydrogenerator
ftbquest.stage_3.quests30.description0: For the time being, oxygen is just a byproduct, it will be useful once you become spacefaring.
ftbquest.stage_3.quests30.title: Oxygen
ftbquest.stage_3.quests31.description0: Electrolyze the hydrogen sulfide to get not only sulfur, but all of your hydrogen back, you may use it as a closed cycle.
ftbquest.stage_3.quests31.tasks1.title: Automated
ftbquest.stage_3.quests31.title: Sulfur Recovery
ftbquest.stage_3.quests32.description0: Heavy diesel requires one extra step into becoming refined diesel, that is &6Hydrocracking&r.
ftbquest.stage_3.quests32.description1: Cracking is essentially breaking heavy hydrocarbons into light hydrocarbons, in this case, with the aid of hydrogen and a catalyst.
ftbquest.stage_3.quests32.tasks1.title: Automated
ftbquest.stage_3.quests32.title: Diesel Hydrocracking
ftbquest.stage_3.quests33.description0: Mystery inbounds the rose quartz, the almost mythical origin of redstone grants it unusual use as a powerful catalyst for cracking hydrocarbons.
ftbquest.stage_3.quests33.title: Powerful Catalyst
ftbquest.stage_3.quests34.description0: Hydrotreating unlike hydrodesulfurization does not allow recovery of the spent hydrogen.
ftbquest.stage_3.quests34.description1: This gas oil can be processed into either alkylate for gasoline mixing or fuel oil + heavy naphta.
ftbquest.stage_3.quests34.description2: &6Tip: process alkylate with priority, if gasoline mixing becomes full, process fuel oil + naphta.&r
ftbquest.stage_3.quests34.tasks1.title: Automated
ftbquest.stage_3.quests34.title: Hydrotreating
ftbquest.stage_3.quests35.description0: The vacuum distillation column is the last of the three and yields the heaviest of fractions that still remain.
ftbquest.stage_3.quests35.tasks0.title: Done
ftbquest.stage_3.quests35.title: Vacuum Distillation
ftbquest.stage_3.quests36.description0: Top fraction out of the vacuum distillation, also yielded by atmospheric distillation, combine both outputs.
ftbquest.stage_3.quests36.tasks1.title: Automated
ftbquest.stage_3.quests37.description0: Middle fraction out of vacuum distillation, heavier counterpart of gas oil.
ftbquest.stage_3.quests37.tasks1.title: Automated
ftbquest.stage_3.quests38.description0: The absolute heaviest fraction of all. Use to obtain petcoke, lubricant and asphalt.
ftbquest.stage_3.quests38.tasks1.title: Automated
ftbquest.stage_3.quests39.description0: Electrolyzing water with salt creates a reaction results into caustic soda and chlorine, don't try at home!

ftbquest.stage_3.quests39.tasks1.title: Automated
ftbquest.stage_3.quests39.title: Caustics
ftbquest.stage_3.quests40.description0: Like oxygen, chlorine is just a byproduct for now.
ftbquest.stage_3.quests41.description0: Mercaptan oxidation (Merox) is a process used to remove mercaptans from kerosene and lighter fractions.
ftbquest.stage_3.quests41.description1: Both hydrodesulfurization and merox are required to meet RP-1 fuel standards.
ftbquest.stage_3.quests41.tasks1.title: Automated
ftbquest.stage_3.quests41.title: Merox Treatment
ftbquest.stage_3.quests42.description0: Use steam as an agent to perform &6thermocracking&r, cracking with heat.
ftbquest.stage_3.quests42.description1: Cracking is essentially breaking heavy hydrocarbons into light hydrocarbons, in this case, with the aid of steam's heat.
ftbquest.stage_3.quests42.tasks1.title: Automated
ftbquest.stage_3.quests42.title: Thermocracking
ftbquest.stage_3.quests43.description0: Further process ethylene into polyethylene exposing it to air for polimerization.
ftbquest.stage_3.quests43.description1: Plastic is not useful as of now, but it will be a key material in later chapters.
ftbquest.stage_3.quests43.tasks1.title: Automated
ftbquest.stage_3.quests43.title: Polimerization

ftbquest.stage_3.quests44.tasks1.title: Automated
ftbquest.stage_3.quests44.title: Propane

ftbquest.stage_3.quests46.title: LPG mixer

ftbquest.stage_3.quests48.title: Delayed Coking

ftbquest.stage_3.quests55.title: Untreated Gasoline
